rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent dominant mass across views, with a stepped/canted upper volume and a fairly clean overall silhouette, so gesture clarity and repair integrity are acceptable. However, the visible mass barely acknowledges the verified access edge: the blue frontage is met by a mostly sealed side rather than a public void, undercut, entry seam, or terrace-like threshold. The courtyard/void idea exists in the genotype, but it is not legible in the rendered massing, so void_publicness and program fit are weak. Programmatically, neighborhood living / neighborhood commercial requires an active ground threshold and a usable public-space figure; this object behaves more like a compact sculpted block with an upper set-back than a street-building with an explicit public edge. The stepped profile is not egregious, but it is not yet a meaningful inhabited section; section_program_fit remains low. References point toward courtyard-centered commercial masses and a grounded public base, but the candidate is too closed and too object-like to resonate strongly.
